description: This file is an Objective-C source file implementing a command-line utility to upload symbol files to a server, including functions for parsing symbol file data, setting up upload parameters, and executing the upload process.

methods.name: ModuleDataForSymbolFile
methods.description: Reads the symbol file, extracts module data such as OS, CPU, UUID, and module name, and returns it as an array of strings.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Prepares and executes the upload of the symbol file to the specified URL, setting parameters and handling the response.

methods.name: Usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the command-line utility.

methods.name: SetupOptions
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to set up the options for the upload process.
